title: Monash University | Lead Teaching Associate
content: Teach and guide first-year engineering students through statics, material properties, and structural analysis, while enhancing their technical, communication, and teamwork skills.Instruct students on using Prusa FDM printers, SolidWorks, and Cura Slicer, focusing on key printer settings for successful designs and projects. I am grateful to be a teaching associate for a fundamental first-year unit known as ENG1011: Engineering Methods. In this role, I guide students through the complexities of statics, material properties, and structural analysis. Together, we delve into designing, constructing, and testing structural components like beams, cantilevers, and truss sections. Through collaborative tasks, I help students not only develop technical skills but also enhance their communication and teamwork abilities, preparing them to tackle intricate engineering challenges across disciplines.       Additionally, I have the privilege of teaching and guiding students in using a Prusa FDM printer (i3 mk3), SolidWorks, and Cura Slicer. We rigorously emphasise and teach students the importance of different printer settings. Monash University ENG1011 Unit Handbook (2025)

title: StartMate Student Fellowship 2025
content: Participated in the Startmate Student Fellowship Program, a two-week startup bootcamp with students from Australia and New Zealand.Collaborated on generating business ideas, validating them with customers, and developing product prototypes.Gained valuable mentorship from industry leaders, deepening my understanding of startup dynamics and entrepreneurship. I am honored to have been selected for the Startmate Student Fellowship Program, a prestigious startup bootcamp. Over two weeks, I delved deep into the startup ecosystem, collaborating with a diverse group of driven students from across Australia and New Zealand. Together, we generated and validated business ideas, engaged directly with potential customers, and developed prototype products. The program provided invaluable mentorship from industry leaders and culminated in pitching our startup concepts to top investors. This experience has equipped me with a comprehensive understanding of startup dynamics and has fueled my passion for entrepreneurship. StartMate Student Fellowship Program

title: SunAware | Co-Founder
content: Co-founder and CTO of SunAware, a startup that participated in an intensive Berkeley Extension program, accelerating its journey from ideation to pitching to Silicon Valley investors. As Co-founder and CTO of SunAware, I led the development of an innovative solution to track and raise awareness about sun exposure, addressing the critical issue of skin cancer risk. Our startup was selected for an intensive Berkeley Extension accelerator program, where we transformed our idea into a validated business model.       Through rapid prototyping, customer validation, and strategic mentorship, we developed a prototype and refined our market entry strategy. The experience culminated in a high-stakes pitch to Silicon Valley investors, pushing us to navigate the complexities of startup growth within an accelerated two-week timeline. title: UBS | Investment Banking Challenge Participant
content: Selected as a top participant from 550+ applicants for a two-week intensive program, collaborating with a team to develop an acquisition solution for a private equity client, conducting research, data analysis, DCF and LBO valuations, and presenting findings to UBS executives in Sydney. Selected as one of the top participants from over 550 applicants, I had the privilege of joining the highly competitive 2023 UBS Investment Banking (IB) Development Challenge. This program provided an immersive experience into the world of investment banking, led by UBS-one of the world's top financial institutions.       Throughout the challenge, I:  Engaged in intensive workshops, networking panels, and hands-on case studies to develop key industry skills. Worked in a high-performing team to craft an acquisition strategy for a private equity client, conducting financial modeling (DCF & LBO) and market research. Developed and presented a professional pitch deck to senior UBS bankers in Sydney, defending our recommendations in a rigorous Q&A session.  This experience refined my analytical and strategic thinking skills while offering firsthand exposure to the fast-paced world of investment banking. title: Monash Business School Industry & Alumni Mentoring Program | Mentee
content: Selected for Monash Business School's Industry & Alumni Mentoring Program, paired with a mentor with 30+ years of experience in private and ASX-listed businesses.Participated in one-on-one mentoring, personal development workshops, and expanded my industry network.Gained valuable insights into business strategy, leadership, and career progression, laying a strong foundation for professional success. The Industry & Alumni Mentoring Program is Monash Business School's flagship leadership initiative, connecting students with experienced professionals for career guidance and industry insights.       In 2022, I was selected for this highly regarded program and paired with a mentor who had over 30 years of experience running private and ASX-listed businesses. Through weekly mentoring sessions over three months, I gained invaluable insights into business strategy, leadership, and professional growth.       My experience included:  Engaging in one-on-one mentoring to refine my career trajectory and business acumen. Participating in personal development workshops to strengthen my leadership, networking, and communication skills. Expanding my industry network by connecting with alumni and professionals across various sectors.        This program provided a strong foundation for professional success, equipping me with the tools to navigate complex business environments and career progression. title: The Bicycle Corporation Pty. Ltd. | Employee
